prompt:
You are the requirements analyst of an AI agent factory. A requester wants an AI assistant
that answers questions from a set of documents. Read the BRIEF and the DOCUMENT OVERVIEW and
draft the requirements.

BRIEF:
I need an assistant that answers HR policy questions for our shore staff: leave of all kinds, public holidays, business travel and expense claims, working hours, remote work and the code of conduct. It should also answer questions about the company pension scheme.

DOCUMENT OVERVIEW:
- code_of_conduct.md (md, 1 page(s), 186 words)
  keywords: manager, gifts, must, code, hours, office, line, work
  starts: # Seaview Shipping Ltd - Code of Conduct (Shore Staff) ## Working hours Standard office hours are 09:00 to 18:00, Monday to Friday, with a one-hour lunch break. Flexible start times between 08:00 and 10:00 are allowed with line manager agreement. ## Remote work Employees may work from home up
- leave_policy.pdf (pdf, 2 page(s), 269 words)
  keywords: leave, days, annual, paid, working, shore, staff, entitled
  starts: Seaview Shipping Ltd - Leave Policy for Shore Staff (version 3, 2026) This policy applies to all permanent shore-based employees. Crew on board vessels are covered by the Seafarers Employment Agreement instead. 1. Annual leave Shore staff are entitled to 24 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year.
- travel_expenses_policy.pdf (pdf, 2 page(s), 195 words)
  keywords: travel, approval, claims, business, approved, department, head, days
  starts: Seaview Shipping Ltd - Business Travel and Expenses Policy (2026) 1. Approval All business travel must be approved in advance by the line manager. International travel also requires approval from the department head. 2. Flights Employees travel in economy class. Business class is allowed only for flights longer than 8

Write:
- agent_name: 2-4 lowercase words joined by underscores, e.g. "hr_policy_assistant"
- purpose: one sentence: what the assistant does and for whom
- scope: one or two sentences: what it covers
- audience: who will use it
- tone: e.g. "formal and concise"
- must_answer_topics: 3-10 short topics the assistant must answer. Use topics the BRIEF asks for.
- must_refuse_topics: 2-6 short topics it must refuse (outside the brief, or risky: legal, medical, personal data...)

These are DESIGN requirements for the assistant, not answers to employees' questions.

Reply with JSON only.
raw_output:
{
  "agent_name": "hr_policy_assistant",
  "purpose": "Answer HR policy questions for shore staff, including leave, public holidays, business travel, expense claims, working hours, remote work, and the company pension scheme.",
  "scope": "The assistant will cover all HR policies related to shore-based employees, including leave, public holidays, business travel, expense claims, working hours, remote work, and the company pension scheme.",
  "audience": "Seaview Shipping Ltd shore-based employees",
  "tone": "formal and concise",
  "must_answer_topics": [
    "leave of all kinds",
    "public holidays",
    "business travel and expense claims",
    "working hours",
    "remote work",
    "code of conduct",
    "company pension scheme"
  ],
  "must_refuse_topics": [
    "legal",
    "medical",
    "personal data"
  ]
}
